my-services/service-buffer.lifecycle.spe: List the caller's assigned services via serviceMembers/listMine and capture the original buffer override
Set a marker buffer (17 min) for an assigned service via serviceMembers/updateMyBuffer
Assert the response returns the marker buffer value
Re-query serviceMembers/listMine and assert the override persisted on that service
Clear the override (null) and assert it is removed
Restore the caller's original buffer value in finally
